Audio Visualizer

Watch a live frequency-bar visualizer from your microphone or any audio file.

Microphone audio is processed locally and never recorded or sent anywhere. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose Microphone or Upload a file.
  2. Press Start.
  3. Watch the live frequency bars.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What can be the sound source?

Either: grant microphone access for a live input, or upload an audio file to visualize.

How does the visualization work?

An AnalyserNode computes real-time frequency data, drawn as animated bars on canvas.

Is my microphone audio private?

Microphone audio is processed locally and never recorded or sent anywhere.
